faq.q: How much does Major Law Firm charge?
faq.a: Major Law Firm publishes no fee terms on the pages we read, so none is recorded on this profile. An absence here is not a claim that the firm has no fee arrangement, only that it does not state one publicly. The rate itself is not published, so ask for it in writing, along with how case expenses are handled and whether they come out of the recovery before or after the fee. The first consultation is free, which is the place to ask.

faq.q: Does Major Law Firm offer a free consultation?
faq.a: Yes. Major Law Firm publishes a free initial consultation. The intake line is published as open around the clock and it publishes material in Spanish.

faq.q: Where does Major Law Firm have offices?
faq.a: Major Law Firm publishes two offices, in San Antonio and Phoenix. Addresses and the Google listing behind each one are on this profile under Offices.

faq.q: Who are the attorneys at Major Law Firm?
faq.a: Major Law Firm names four attorneys on its own site, and each is listed on this profile with the page we read them from. They have not been checked against a state register: Texas does not publish an attorney register we can query, so licensure is not verified here. The state's own attorney search is the place to check it.

faq.q: What has Law Firm Listings verified about Major Law Firm?
faq.a: Major Law Firm scores 47 and sits at Verified. Passed: website and footprint. Did not pass: entity registration. Could not be answered from any public source and therefore counts neither for nor against the firm: licensure and discipline. Every row of the scorecard above names where the value came from and when it was read. Nothing on this profile was supplied by the firm for payment, and no placement here can be bought.
